2. Mr. Raunak Pant, learned counsel 
holding brief of Mr. Naresh Pant, learned 
counsel for respondents/NHAI.
3. The grievance which is canvassed by 
the petitioner is limited to the fact that 
respondents-NHAI is constructing 
underground culvert on NH-74 at village 
Talli, Bajpur and the land of petitioner is 
just adjoining to this culvert and petitioner 
wants respondents-NHAI to raise the 
concrete drainage on the both side of NH￾74 so that water would not flow the field of 
petitioner i.e. Khasra No.202/1 and 202/2.
If the concrete drain is not constructed, it 
would damage the crops of petitioner.
4. Learned counsel for respondents-NHAI 
shall get instructions in the matter within a 
week.
5. Put up as fresh on 12.05.2026.
 (Pankaj Purohit, J.)
